statement_a: My favorite programming language is Java.
statement_b: My favorite programming language is Python.
explanation: Same preference attribute with two mutually exclusive values.

statement_a: I developed my college project using Java.
statement_b: I built the same project entirely using Python.
explanation: Same project claimed to be built in two different languages without a migration cue.

statement_b: I live in Mumbai.
explanation: A person cannot currently live in two different cities as a single present-tense fact.

statement_b: My name is Riya.
explanation: Two different personal names for the same speaker.

statement_b: I am 18 years old.
explanation: Conflicting age values without a time-gap explanation.

statement_b: I am learning Python.
explanation: A degree subject and a skill being learned can both be true.

statement_b: Project Beta uses Python.
explanation: Different named projects may use different languages.

statement_b: I have an exam on Friday.
explanation: Unrelated personal facts.

statement_a: I use React for the frontend.
statement_b: The backend is written in Django.
explanation: Frontend and backend technologies can coexist.

statement_b: My college is located in Pune.
explanation: Internship and college location are compatible.

statement_b: I study CS at college.
explanation: The second statement restates the same field of study.

statement_a: My favorite programming language is Java.
statement_b: Java is the language I like most.
explanation: Paraphrase of the same preference.

statement_a: I built a chatbot using Streamlit.
statement_b: My chatbot interface is implemented with Streamlit.
explanation: The later sentence supports the earlier technology claim.

statement_b: Assignment 4 is already done.
explanation: Restatement of completion.

statement_b: Pune is my current city.
explanation: Equivalent location statements.

statement_b: Correction: my exam is on Tuesday.
explanation: Explicit correction marker should update the exam date.

statement_b: Actually, the deadline is 12 October.
explanation: 'Actually' signals a correction of the stored date.

statement_b: Sorry, I meant I will submit the report tomorrow.
explanation: 'I meant' is an explicit repair of the previous claim.

statement_b: Let me correct that: my team has five members.
explanation: User explicitly asks to correct a numeric fact.

statement_a: I use Java for this project.
statement_b: I migrated the project to Python.
explanation: Migration language describes a later state, not a silent conflict.

statement_b: I switched my favorite language to Rust.
explanation: 'Switched' indicates a preference change over time.

statement_b: I moved to PyTorch last semester.
explanation: A later tool choice can replace an earlier one.

statement_a: I used to live in Delhi.
statement_b: I now live in Pune.
explanation: 'Used to' plus 'now' describes relocation, not a logic error.

statement_b: I have not completed the project.
explanation: Negation of the same completion claim about the same project.

statement_b: I do not like Java.
explanation: Affirmation versus negation of the same preference.

statement_b: The model has never been trained.
explanation: 'Never' contradicts a completed-training claim.

statement_b: I didn't finish the NLP assignment.
explanation: Direct negation of assignment completion.

statement_a: I built a chatbot using Java.
statement_b: It now uses Python.
explanation: 'It' may refer to the chatbot, but the system should ask before asserting a conflict.

statement_a: I created a website for the college fest.
statement_b: The app is written in Kotlin.
explanation: Website versus app may or may not be the same system.

statement_b: They switched the database to SQLite.
explanation: 'They' needs confirmation before treating it as the same team.

statement_b: The project depends on NLTK instead.
explanation: Capstone and 'the project' might be the same, but this should be clarified.

statement_b: That system currently runs in the cloud.
explanation: 'That system' is a vague reference to the earlier deployment.

statement_b: I also know pandas.
explanation: Additional skills do not contradict existing skills.

statement_b: Update: the presentation is on Friday.
explanation: 'Update:' is treated as an explicit correction of schedule.
